name: KOReader
summary: Ebook and PDF reader with dictionaries, notes and library management

description.en: An ebook reader for PDF, EPUB, DjVu, CBZ and FB2 with reflow, dictionary lookup, highlights, page cropping and multi-column support. Built for e-ink devices but works well on Android tablets and phones.
description.pt: Leitor de ebooks para PDF, EPUB, DjVu, CBZ e FB2 com reflow, consulta de dicionário, destaques, recorte de páginas e suporte multi-coluna. Feito para e-ink, mas funciona bem em tablets e telefones Android.

author: KOReader contributors
notes: O repo publica builds noturnas num tag prerelease chamado 'ota' com centenas de assets; tagPattern=v* restringe aos releases estáveis.

summaryTranslations.pt: Leitor de ebooks e PDF com dicionários, notas e gestão de biblioteca
